## LV Enrichment — LOCAL LIVE (headless, real providers)
Real Lusha (GET v2) + Apollo (people/match, reveal) + ZoomInfo (cached GTM token) + HubSpot SEARCH — all keyed off `$env` (pass via `docker exec -e`). Run: `scripts/n8n_enrichment_live_replica.sh`.

**Read-only:** live provider calls + HubSpot search only. NO write nodes — Decide Action echoes the would-be payload. Real ICP prospects; none skip.

**Two sibling branches off one trigger** (companies is NOT nested under contacts): the ICP fields are per-DOMAIN and expensive, so nesting would re-pay for every contact at the same company. Companies dedupes by domain; contacts join back on domain. Company branch = Lusha `/v2/company` + Apollo `/v1/organizations/enrich` + ZoomInfo GTM `/companies/enrich` — all three confirmed 200 live (2026-07-20).
